name: RwlRwlRwlRwl!
summary: A library keeper welcomes magical works for the library's collection. Your contributions help its knowledge grow.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: Each addition broadens the knowledge held there, and the keeper thanks you for it. More works that may benefit the collection are welcome.

faq.q: What does the library keeper want?
faq.answer: The keeper welcomes magical works that may benefit the Library's collection.
No city is named. Books like this one go to Garion Wendell in Stormwind or Owen Thadd in Undercity.
Your contributions help the library's knowledge grow.
